reflection.definition: the derivation is run under both kappa orientations (kappa0 = the claim-free BFS scaffold, kappa1 = its reflection)
reflection.statement: the seven pair sets are identical under both orientations; only the coordinate labels flip (c -> 6-c). The pair structure is reflection-invariant; the orientation labelling is reflection-relative and the one-bit dependency is carried to BL-065, never resolved here. The direction probes are mask functions and orientation-independent.

equivalence.statement: pre-registered equivalence holds: the coordinate-side rule (kappa only) and the child-side rule (masks only) generate the same pair sets. The pairs exist because kappa exists, and kappa exists because the masks' Hamming geometry exists; the grant is reachable from the geometry in two provably-equivalent formulations.

kBdy.definition: coordinate-side (masks + rotation): the two unordered A0 pairs in T+/-1 rotation relation (the seam pairs); equivalently the wrap pairs of the cyclic rule at centers 0 and 6

kInt.definition: coordinate-side (kappa): for each internal position c = 1..5, the unordered pair {kappa^-1(c-1), kappa^-1(c+1)}

sInt.definition: child-side (masks): for each A1 mask h, N(h) = {a in A0 : hamming12(a, h) = 2}; if |N(h)| = 2 then constructors = N(h); the containment sandwich holds on that unique pair

tBdy.definition: child-side (masks): for each A1 mask h with |N(h)| = 1, constructors = the sole Hamming-2 neighbour plus its unique T+/-1 rotation twin; the sandwich fails on this pair

unified.definition: the seven constructor pairs are exactly the seven cyclic distance-2 pairs in kappa: for c = 0..6, {kappa^-1((c+6) mod 7), kappa^-1((c+1) mod 7)}; midZ7 of each pair's positions equals c
unified.midpointStatement: midZ7(c-1, c+1) = (4*(2c)) mod 7 = c: the coordinate rule and the frozen midpoint law are one relation read in opposite directions; the two boundary centers (0, 6) realize the two observation-exact T1 seam relations, the five internal centers (1..5) realize the five confirmation-marked T2 midpoint predictions (BL-056 G5)
